title: A school decision
prompt: Your school is deciding whether students should help design a new outdoor learning area. Write a persuasive piece to explain your view to the school leadership team.

title: The unexpected message
prompt: Write a story that begins: “The message was meant for someone else, but I knew I had to answer it.”

title: A change of mind
prompt: Write a piece about a time someone changed their mind after discovering something they had not understood.
